arguments.sql: SELECT o.order_date, SUM(ol.quantity * p.unit_price) AS total_amount FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_lines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id INNER JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id WHERE o.id = 168;
